missing_non_mutating_metrics.name: row schema validity
missing_non_mutating_metrics.required_check: Parse JSON/JSONL and count rows by schemaVersion, rowId, pairId, target machine, target adapter, prompt/task, available skills, chosen, rejected, teaching point, and flags.
missing_non_mutating_metrics.pass_condition: Every referenced row parses and every required field is present or explicitly reported missing.

missing_non_mutating_metrics.name: source-disjoint
missing_non_mutating_metrics.required_check: Compare Row13 rows, Row14.2 rows, Row14.4 held-out probe, row ids, pair ids, sourcePromptEntryIds, prompt fingerprints, skill targets, file/path tokens, and candidate orders.
missing_non_mutating_metrics.pass_condition: No train/eval overlap; held-out probe text not copied into training; all overlaps classified.

missing_non_mutating_metrics.name: universal-only
missing_non_mutating_metrics.required_check: Check universalOnly, universalOnlyRationale, and absence of host UI behavior, repo path, locator mechanics, project command detail, or candidate order as the learned signal.
missing_non_mutating_metrics.pass_condition: Rows train a reusable boundary, not a project/host shortcut.

missing_non_mutating_metrics.name: no vendor output
missing_non_mutating_metrics.required_check: Check noVendorOutputDistillationNote, vendorAndPrivacy.noVendorOutput, externalAiUsed, raw private text flags, and closed API distillation claims.
missing_non_mutating_metrics.pass_condition: No vendor output, no copied vendor answer, no external AI training evidence unless explicitly allowed.

missing_non_mutating_metrics.name: quarantine decisions
missing_non_mutating_metrics.required_check: Count KEEP, EVAL_ONLY, QUARANTINE, REWRITE, REMOVE decisions; verify held-out rows are not train rows.
missing_non_mutating_metrics.pass_condition: Every row has a quarantine decision and reason; any missing/unsafe row is not train-ready.

missing_non_mutating_metrics.name: chosen/rejected contrast
missing_non_mutating_metrics.required_check: Verify chosen/rejected are non-identical, plausible near-miss rejected exists, chosen wins for a stated teaching point, and confidence/second-pass fields are present when available.
missing_non_mutating_metrics.pass_condition: The contrast teaches one semantic decision boundary and not row id/path/order leakage.

missing_non_mutating_metrics.name: provenance fields
missing_non_mutating_metrics.required_check: Check sourcePromptEntryId, source root or synthetic-source note, source/license/private leg, source hash when available, provider/model/request/terms fields when applicable, train/eval role, leakage flags, decision boundary, and teaching point.
missing_non_mutating_metrics.pass_condition: Missing fields are counted and blocked from broad train-ready claims.

missing_non_mutating_metrics.name: privacy/distillation checks
missing_non_mutating_metrics.required_check: Confirm rawPrivateTextCopied=false, no private prompt leakage, no local path leakage in trainable features, no closed API distillation, and source/license route is explicit.
missing_non_mutating_metrics.pass_condition: Any private/vendor/unknown-license issue becomes quarantine or evidence-only.

missing_non_mutating_metrics.name: training/eval separation
missing_non_mutating_metrics.required_check: Verify Row14.2 train rows, Row14.3 staged training step, Row14.4 eval-only held-out probe, and staged hash unchanged after eval.
missing_non_mutating_metrics.pass_condition: Evaluation rows are not copied into training; Row15 itself performs no training/eval/UI.
